info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Trials-v2-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Trials Retrieval API enables users to access information about trial subscriptions for streaming services. This endpoint supports GET requests to retrieve a list of active trials, catering to potential customers evaluating subscription options. Typical consumers include marketing teams and product managers assessing user engagement and trial performance. By leveraging this endpoint, businesses can make informed decisions to enhance their subscription offerings and improve customer acquisition strategies.

get.description: Fetch a list of trial subscriptions available in the system. This endpoint allows users to view and manage their trial subscription options efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving trial subscription details. The body must include necessary information to identify the trial subscription, as specified in the schema.

204.description: Request was successful, but there is no content to return.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsRequest.description: This schema represents the body of a GET request for trial subscriptions in the application, formatted as a JSON string.
